items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: And then I did a thing at the Strand Theater when he was in the band, with Cab, yeah.

ctx.x: Had you played with Panama in New York?
Oh, when I was with Lucky Millender we worked together. And then I did a thing at the Strand Theater when he was in the band, with Cab, yeah.
O.K., so was it with Jimmy Rochelle...you had been with him and then you went into Kelly Martin's Band?
